'''''Space Drifter''''' was a [[medium freighter]] owned and operated by [[Core to Rim Shipping]]. The [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] was commanded by the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Prem Nistt]].
